abstract: The present study was carried out to determine if an insulin-like growth factor (IGF) type activity might be produced by embryonal carcinoma-derived cells. The cell line used to condition growth medium for the isolation of secreted growth factors was a newly established Dif 5 cell type. Dif 5 cells are a differentiated endoderm-like cell type derived from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells (which possess properties similar to mouse embryonic stem cells) following extensive exposure to retinoic acid. When growth medium conditioned by Dif 5 cells is chromatographed on Sephadex G-75 in 1 M acetic acid two peaks of activity are observed which compete for specific [125I]iodo multiplication stimulating activity (MSA) binding to PYS cells. MSA is the rat homologue of human IGF-II. The high molecular weight fraction (Mr approximately 60K) apparently corresponds to IGF-binding protein as determined by its ability to bind [125I]iodo-MSA. The low molecular weight fraction (Mr approximately 8K) is biologically active as this fraction stimulates [3H]thymidine incorporation into serum-starved chick embryo fibroblasts. Radioimmunoassay data indicate that the IGF-like activity produced by Dif 5 cells is more closely related to IGF-II than to IGF-I. Undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma stem cell lines (F9, Nulli, and PCC4) produced little of this MSA-like activity, while PYS-2 (parietal endoderm-like) cells produced about 16 ng MSA/10(6) cells/24 hr as determined by radioimmunoassay. Dif 5 and PSA-5E (visceral endoderm-like) cells, are found to secrete significant amounts of MSA into the growth medium (30-50 ng MSA/10(6) cells/24 hr). These findings offer further support to a proposal that MSA (IGF-II) produced by endoderm cells, particularly visceral endoderm, may serve as an early embryonic growth factor.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌由来細胞がIGF型活性を産生するかを検討した。条件培地として用いた細胞株は新たに樹立されたDif 5細胞である。Dif 5細胞は、マウス胚性幹細胞に類似した性質を持つF9胎児性癌細胞を、レチノイン酸に長期間曝露して得られた内胚葉様の分化細胞である。Dif 5細胞の条件培地を1M酢酸中のSephadex G-75でクロマトグラフィーにかけると、[125I]ヨード標識MSAの特異的結合(PYS細胞への結合)を競合する2つの活性ピークが得られた。MSAはヒトIGF-IIのラット相同体である。高分子量画分(Mr約60K)は、[125I]ヨード標識MSAに結合する能力からIGF結合タンパク質に相当すると考えられた。低分子量画分(Mr約8K)は、血清飢餓状態のニワトリ胚線維芽細胞への[3H]チミジン取り込みを刺激するため生物活性を持つ。Dif 5細胞が産生するIGF様活性は、ラジオイムノアッセイによりIGF-Iよりも IGF-IIとの関連が強いことが示された。未分化胎児性癌幹細胞株(F9、Nulli、PCC4)はほとんどMSA様活性を産生しなかったが、PYS-2(壁側内胚葉様)細胞は約16 ng MSA/10^6細胞/24時間を産生した。Dif 5およびPSA-5E(臓側内胚葉様)細胞は、培地中に有意量のMSA(30〜50 ng MSA/10^6細胞/24時間)を分泌した。これらの知見は、内胚葉細胞、特に臓側内胚葉が産生するMSA(IGF-II)が初期胚の成長因子として働くという仮説を支持する。
